Tests-only LAS 2.0.5 regrade of the unchanged preserved gpt-5.6-luna Max JavaScript source. The previous 2.0.4 publication scored 215/223; the corrected suite scores 219/223 with no skips or errors. All 219 unaffected node identities and outcomes are identical, and the four renamed zero-waveform cases pass. Their fixtures now retain valid file-level descriptors and storage, changing only the point's waveform association. Descriptor index zero is a per-point absence marker and does not unambiguously waive separately required file metadata. Any previous classification of metadata/storage-free zero-waveform rejection as a proven model defect is withdrawn. The old publication and prior audit chain are preserved in full. Unchanged observed failure families: internal waveform packet interval validation. Exact failed nodes: test_validation.py::test_inspect_rejects_waveform_packet_outside_payload[2-4]; test_validation.py::test_inspect_rejects_waveform_packet_outside_payload[60-5]; test_validation.py::test_render_rejects_waveform_packet_outside_payload[2-4]; test_validation.py::test_render_rejects_waveform_packet_outside_payload[60-5]. Repeated format/action observations are not counts of independent implementation bugs. The original completion, source/transcript and accounting reviews remain applicable to the unchanged generation; their full historical editorial text remains in the linked prior publication. Root and an independent reviewer checked the revised public-contract interpretation, focused reference/mutation controls, source preservation and per-case comparison. Claims complete; local syntax/all-format smoke tests are supported, but the remaining interval defect was not acknowledged. The first format sweep printed failures with shell status zero; corrected sweeps succeeded. Some CRS, padding, WKT and bad-kind negatives were ineffective or confounded. Later padding and Extra Bytes probes were corrected. Final local checks covered syntax, opaque records, padding, external waveform and CLI behavior, with no final full format sweep. Original raw result/source hashes, generation metadata, input/output/cache/reasoning token totals and recorded cost are retained. Current usage is independently reparsed from preserved events. The regrade makes no new model calls and adds no generation cost. Reasoning remains an output subset. Any separate tool-count recovery is explicitly linked and preserves its historical evidence.

Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.

editorial.last_message: Claims complete and reports syntax/all-format round-trip checks, which the transcript supports as focused smoke tests. Grading found 8 failures: descriptor-free zero-waveform files are rejected, and internal waveform packet bounds are not enforced in inspect/render. These limitations were not acknowledged.
editorial.notes:
Completed voluntarily with a general standard-library Node LAS parser/renderer. Final grading is 215/223 with no skips or errors. The eight failures cover two defect families: an unconditional format-level requirement for waveform descriptors/storage rejects four valid all-zero waveform files, and missing packet interval validation permits header overlap or payload overflow through both inspect and render. These observations are not eight independent bugs. Root verified the existing tests against the public zero-descriptor and header-relative offset/size rules; opaque waveform sample bytes do not remove outer bounds requirements. No new fixture ambiguity or broad failure amplification was found; these are the same two families documented for Luna C++ under LAS 2.0.4. Independent review supports the substantial implementation and historical syntax/all-format smoke claims, but the final answer does not acknowledge the remaining defects. The first all-format attempt printed failures despite exit 0; the corrected sweep and later format-number assertions succeeded. Their waveform fixtures always included descriptors/storage.
